title: St. Patrick’s Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office celebrates St. Patrick's Day with various personal and professional dynamics unfolding. Michael enthusiastically embraces the holiday with themed treats and symbolic gifts, while Dwight showcases his obsession with expanding his workspace through the Mega-Desk. Andy and Erin prepare nervously for their first date, despite Erin feeling slightly ill. Jo holds a town hall meeting to encourage employee ideas, leading to Darryl's proposal for shipping improvements and an offer of a new office space. Michael contemplates his career and relationship with Jo, ultimately canceling a planned trip to focus on work and the office celebration. The episode highlights interpersonal conflicts, budding relationships, and workplace humor centered around the holiday.
